quote: Statkraft has decided to invest in Gran Sul, a 280 MW onshore wind project in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil… With the investment decision, Gran Sul now moves into the execution phase, construction scheduled to begin in January 2027.
note: Opened Statkraft English GlobeNewswire primary 2026-10-04; 280 MW / Jan 2027 construction start confirmed; CapEx undisclosed.
